finding.reason: The observer needs an activating/start oneshot sample. Without nonblocking submission, the launcher waits for unit startup completion, conflicting with that lifecycle window.

primarySource.interpretation: Protocol/lifecycle inference from primary documentation, not a measurement of the VPS systemd version.

nextLocalCorrection: Create a new candidate copy, never overwrite the sealed 149-case candidate.
